title: Ryoku Batteries readers
description: Which battery readers the Batteries bar widget runs. Global display options live in QS Bar Settings; this file is per-reader.

id.description: Unique name; also the device key prefix, so renaming it resets bar visibility.

builtin.description: A reader shipped with the plugin.

cmd.description: argv of your own reader, run without a shell. Leading ~ is expanded. It must print {"devices": [...]} (see README).

interval.description: Seconds between runs; 0 = every poll (the Poll interval setting).

timeout.description: Seconds before the reader is killed and shown as an error.

label.description: Display name; applies when the reader reports exactly one device.

kind.description: Picks the icon. Overrides what the reader reports.

icon.description: A Nerd Font glyph to use instead of the kind's icon.
